reference_sql:
WITH mapped AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT p.product_id,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs') THEN 'TV & Video' ELSE c.parent_category END AS parent_category,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_parent_spelling
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON LOWER(c.category_name) = LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw))
)
SELECT parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_products, SUM(is_parent_spelling) AS n_parent_spelling
FROM mapped
WHERE parent_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY parent_category
